product.title: Authentic Private Everglades Airboat Tour

description.text: Glide through the Florida Everglades on a private airboat ride near Fort Lauderdale, with time to spot wildlife and learn about the unique wetland ecosystem from your captain guide.

highlights: Private airboat experience through Everglades waterways
Great chance to spot local wildlife and birds
Personalized commentary from your local captain
Easy day trip format from Fort Lauderdale

start.description: Meeting point details are shared after booking confirmation.

itineraryItems.title: Meet your captain
itineraryItems.description: Arrive at the departure point and receive a short safety briefing.

itineraryItems.title: Private airboat ride
itineraryItems.description: Cruise deep into the Everglades with a private guide and narrated wildlife viewing.

itineraryItems.title: Return to dock
itineraryItems.description: Head back to the launch area and wrap up your experience.

faqs.question: Is this a private tour?
faqs.answer: Yes, the airboat is reserved for your private group.

faqs.question: How long is the experience?
faqs.answer: The experience lasts about 1 hour and 30 minutes.
